description: FOC root parent and proposed gap requirements. All gap items are review status and require human approval.

requirements.title: Motor Control System Requirements Baseline
requirements.statement: The PMSM field-oriented-control architecture shall be allocated to the motor-control software components and shall trace to the inverter/motor system requirements.
requirements.source: Placeholder parent injected by the hardening system
requirements.rationale: The source CSV has no system/stakeholder hierarchy. This placeholder enables traceability without inventing a stakeholder requirement.
open_issues: Placeholder system parent; replace with the real inverter/motor system requirement and confirm ASIL allocation.

requirements.title: Phase Current Sensor Loss
requirements.statement: When a phase-current measurement is invalid for more than 100 us, the motor controller shall disable current control and force the inverter to a safe state.
requirements.source: Gap analysis: ISO 26262-6 fault reaction, ASPICE SWE.4
requirements.rationale: The source monitors overcurrent but does not define the reaction to loss of a phase-current measurement.
open_issues: 100 us reaction and inverter safe state are proposed; confirm with the motor-control safety analysis.

requirements.title: PWM and Inverter Fault Reaction
requirements.statement: When the PWM stage or inverter reports a fault, the motor controller shall disable PWM outputs and set the motor protection status to the hard-fault state.
requirements.rationale: The source defines a protection reaction but not the PWM/inverter fault interface and hard-fault state.
open_issues: Confirm the inverter fault signals and the safe PWM state.

requirements.title: DC Bus Fault Reaction
requirements.statement: When the DC-bus voltage exceeds the calibrated overvoltage threshold or falls below the calibrated undervoltage threshold, the motor controller shall disable torque production and set the DC-bus fault status.
requirements.rationale: The source detects DC-bus over/undervoltage but does not define the torque-disable reaction.
open_issues: Confirm the torque-disable reaction and recovery thresholds.

requirements.title: Motor Overtemperature Derating
requirements.statement: The motor controller shall derate the maximum q-axis current linearly from the calibrated derating start temperature to zero at the calibrated maximum temperature.
requirements.rationale: The source defines a derating slope and hysteresis but not the full temperature-to-zero mapping.
open_issues: Confirm the derating start/max temperatures and slope with the motor calibration.

requirements.title: Position and Speed Observer Fault
requirements.statement: When the position or speed observer is invalid for more than 1 ms, the motor controller shall disable torque production and set a protection fault.
requirements.source: Gap analysis: position/speed observer safety, ISO 26262-6
requirements.rationale: The source uses the observer but does not define its fault detection or reaction.
open_issues: Confirm the observer validity criteria and 1 ms reaction.

requirements.title: Calibration Verification
requirements.statement: At startup and after a calibration update, the motor controller shall verify that every safety-relevant calibration parameter is within its declared range and consistent with the motor/inverter variant.
requirements.rationale: The source exposes calibration parameters but does not require their verification.
open_issues: Define the safety-relevant calibration list and variant matrix.

requirements.title: Motor and Inverter Variant Configuration
requirements.statement: The motor controller shall select its pole-pair count, resistance, inductance, nominal DC voltage, current limits and derating parameters from a validated motor/inverter variant configuration.
requirements.rationale: The source uses vehicle/motor-dependent parameters but does not define variant selection.
open_issues: Define the variant matrix and configuration source.
requirements.constraint_rationale: Configuration constraint; verified by variant-matrix review and end-of-line test.

requirements.title: Fault Injection and Observability
requirements.statement: The motor controller shall expose test hooks to inject phase-current loss, inverter fault, DC-bus fault, overtemperature and observer faults and shall publish the resulting protection status.
requirements.source: Gap analysis: ASPICE SWE.4, ISO 26262-6 fault injection
requirements.rationale: Verification of the protection mechanisms needs controllability and observability.
open_issues: Confirm the production-disable mechanism for the test hooks.
requirements.constraint_rationale: Verification-enabling constraint; reviewed for production isolation.
